summary: Hebrew marks a definite noun with the prefix ha- (הַ); there is no indefinite article. A definite direct object takes אֶת.

askYourself: Is it the direct object and definite (→ אֶת before it)?

traps: Before ח with kamatz the article becomes הֶ: הֶחָצִיל.
No אֶת before an indefinite object: הוּא אוֹכֵל בָּצָל.
